deckTitle: THE MOVE: A Field Guide to Managed Reactions

cards.power: Frames an existing condition as immediate and universal to justify a response not otherwise available.
cards.lore: The condition may predate the framing; the urgency is introduced when the response requires it.
cards.gradeReason: Clock already ticking before you read the problem. Fire alarm you can't locate. Zero setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Boar pressing red button, alarms everywhere. Mood: Theatrical urgency.

cards.power: Sustains alertness toward dangers whose evidence cannot be independently examined.
cards.lore: Vigilance is maintained for threats described as classified, structural, or too complex to summarize for a general audience.
cards.gradeReason: On watch for something unverifiable. Clear role, but the unverifiability needs one beat to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Owl guard scanning empty horizon with tech binoculars. Mood: Tense absurdity.

cards.power: Extends emergency framing into adjacent domains as each measure reveals new requirements.
cards.lore: The original threat remains formally unresolved while response infrastructure enters areas it never initially addressed.
cards.gradeReason: Emergency that ate the exit. Each new measure produces a new domain. Frog-and-ripples never stops.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Frog on shrinking lily pad, concentric ripples expanding into new zones. Mood: Inevitable drift.

cards.power: Converts a temporary emergency designation into stable infrastructure once adaptation removes the pressure to remove it.
cards.lore: The emergency expires; the systems built under it are now the standard and are no longer described as temporary.
cards.gradeReason: "Temporary" has been there longer than permanent. Clear, but needs the before/after beat to click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Emergency sign rusting into landscape, deer grazing around it unbothered. Mood: Settled permanence.

cards.power: Channels existing frustration toward a specific named target at a specific moment.
cards.lore: Diffuse dissatisfaction acquires an address; the structural conditions producing it do not.
cards.gradeReason: Point and go. Bull charges gate labeled TARGET. Table knows exactly what this card is doing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Bull charging TARGET gate, hand pointing from offscreen, dust rising. Mood: Directed fury.

cards.power: Concentrates distributed accountability onto a single identifiable figure.
cards.lore: A name is provided; the structural conditions that produced the outcome are not named in the same sentence.
cards.gradeReason: Name in spotlight, machine in darkness. Someone is guilty — just not the conditions. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Goat spotlit on stage, dark machinery visible in background shadows. Mood: Ceremonial sacrifice.

cards.power: Converts directed anger into a self-sustaining cycle that requires no further external input.
cards.lore: Each event in the cycle increases receptivity to the next; the cycle no longer needs curating.
cards.gradeReason: Hyenas with TV screens, each triggering the next. Works, but the self-sustaining bit needs modeling.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Hyenas watching screens showing hyenas watching screens, loop visible. Mood: Feverish self-perpetuation.

cards.power: Produces a population sorted into opposed groups whose primary energy flows toward each other rather than outward.
cards.lore: Attention concentrates on the division; the mechanism that produced it operates outside the frame.
cards.gradeReason: Red vs. blue armies facing inward, machine humming offscreen. Performable but requires setup beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Red and blue animal armies facing each other, unseen sorting mechanism implied. Mood: Orchestrated division.

cards.power: Saturates available processing capacity through volume, making navigation more expensive than the decision it informs.
cards.lore: Navigation requires more time than is available; most content goes unread without being suppressed.
cards.gradeReason: Every document at once, none processed. Beaver drowning — you ARE the flood. Zero explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Beaver buried in papers flying through window, dark screen behind. Mood: Overwhelming deliberate saturation.

cards.power: Places credentialed opposing voices on each contested question until no stable factual baseline holds.
cards.lore: For each expert position, a peer-reviewed counter-position is available at identical distribution.
cards.gradeReason: Two credentialed parrots screaming identical contradictions. Fact is now preference. Table chaos, instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Two expert parrots in lab coats screaming opposing papers at each other. Mood: Credentialed destabilization.

cards.power: Distributes authority across subspecialties until no synthesizing voice is structurally available.
cards.lore: The question requires cross-domain assessment; the institution that would coordinate that assessment has not been organized.
cards.gradeReason: Each owl owns a corner, no owl owns the room. Clear but the structural gap needs one beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Ring of owls each pointing to different corners, mouse confused in center. Mood: Fragmented non-authority.

cards.power: Converts unresolvable information load into passive acceptance of the default already in place.
cards.lore: After sufficient exposure to contradictory authoritative claims, people stop choosing and accept what is already there.
cards.gradeReason: Checked everything, now just accepting what's there. Sloth on paperwork. Checkmark already placed. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Sloth asleep on paperwork, default checkbox already ticked, unopened files everywhere. Mood: Exhausted surrender.

cards.power: Introduces genuine support that gradually becomes the only available path for the need it serves.
cards.lore: The service is real; the dependency it produces is a structural output, not a design flaw.
cards.gradeReason: Net is real. Dependency is structural. That's what makes it work. Needs the switch beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Sheep on scaffold platform, scaffold narrowing into only available path. Mood: Genuine aid, structural capture.

cards.power: Conditions essential access on continued enrollment, making exit structurally expensive.
cards.lore: Leaving the system means losing access that was built only through being inside it.
cards.gradeReason: Can't leave. Couldn't leave. Didn't notice the gate was there. Fox guard, instant recognition.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Fox official scanning access pass, queue of animals behind gate, forest beyond. Mood: Institutional lock-in.

cards.power: Converts one-time transactions into recurring relationships requiring active effort to exit.
cards.lore: The service is unchanged; the delivery model ensures return and places exit responsibility on the user.
cards.gradeReason: Squirrel with thirty boxes from one contract. Recognizable, but the exit-responsibility flip needs context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Squirrel surrounded by subscription boxes, reading fine-print contract in disbelief. Mood: Entangled by default.

cards.power: Expands available choices within the system while the practical infrastructure for choices outside it contracts.
cards.lore: Freedom of movement within the system increases as the conditions for movement outside it quietly contract.
cards.gradeReason: Choices expand inside. Outside, the road got narrower. Bird in gorgeous open cage. Sharp.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Colorful bird in ornate open cage, vibrant inside, forest beyond visibly contracting. Mood: Decorated captivity.

cards.power: Ties self-concept to membership until belonging becomes a structural rather than voluntary condition.
cards.lore: The group provides genuine benefits; those benefits become reasons not to evaluate the group on its own terms.
cards.gradeReason: Herd provides genuinely. Benefits become bars. Warm belonging with hidden architecture — needs second pass.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Herd of animals in sunlit field, identity markers visible, fencing subtly present. Mood: Genuine belonging as structure.

cards.power: Introduces visible periodic tests that sort members from non-members without stating the evaluation criteria.
cards.lore: The content of the test matters less than the visible act of passing it.
cards.gradeReason: No criteria stated. Passing visibly is the point. Raccoon at stone door, zero setup needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Raccoon at ancient stone door with glowing palm test, no instructions posted. Mood: Opaque sorting ritual.

cards.power: Converts private doubt into required public display of certainty as the currency of membership.
cards.lore: Public performance of belief becomes required; private disagreement is present but quiet.
cards.gradeReason: Doubt private, certainty currency. Peacock knows this immediately. Private disagreement is quiet. Play it now.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Peacock displaying feathers of certainty to admiring crowd, doubt hidden behind plumage. Mood: Performative conviction.

cards.power: Accumulates relationships, infrastructure, and identity inside the group until leaving means losing several things that cannot be recovered simultaneously.
cards.lore: The exit cost was not imposed as a penalty. It accrued through ordinary participation.
cards.gradeReason: Built your whole life in here. Leaving loses everything, simultaneously. Raccoon pulling threads. Devastating, instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Raccoon in web of belongings and relationships, each thread pulling inward on exit. Mood: Accumulated captivity.

cards.power: Establishes a preferred behavior through expectation rather than requirement.
cards.lore: The behavior is formally optional; consequences for non-compliance distribute informally and consistently.
cards.gradeReason: Optional. Technically. The elephant in the hall of expectations disagrees. Needs second read to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Grand hall of animals, all behaving identically, no order posted anywhere visible. Mood: Formal optional pressure.

cards.power: Uses observed compliance as the primary evidence that compliance is correct.
cards.lore: The behavior spreads because it is visible; the reasoning behind it is rarely articulated.
cards.gradeReason: Everyone following because everyone's following. Circular logic needs landing beat but payoff is strong.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Long animal queue following itself in loop, first animal looking puzzled. Mood: Visible compliance as proof.

cards.power: Arranges the choice architecture so the preferred option requires measurably less friction than alternatives.
cards.lore: The choice is genuinely available; the costs of choosing against the design accumulate in small unannounced increments.
cards.gradeReason: Easy path vs. warning-sign path — both real. Fine-print costs accumulate unseen. Works with context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Donkey at fork: sunny easy path vs. warning-sign-choked alternative. Mood: Designed choice architecture.

cards.power: Produces consistent behavioral alignment through distributed informal costs that are never announced.
cards.lore: No mandate was issued. No penalty was declared. The behavior is consistent.
cards.gradeReason: No rule. No announcement. Everyone behaved. Bear found the narrow path. Three-line lore. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Bear taking narrow paved path, wide path subtly blocked, no signs present. Mood: Silent consistent compliance.

cards.power: Determines which context a fact arrives with before the fact can be examined independently.
cards.lore: The same event produces different public understanding depending on the surrounding material — which is selected.
cards.gradeReason: Same fact, different frame, different world. Crow picks before you see. No explanation required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Crow selecting from three frames around identical object, choosing deliberately. Mood: Cold editorial precision.

cards.power: Aligns multiple institutional voices around a single interpretation in the same window of time.
cards.lore: The alignment is described as independent consensus; its timing is documented and rarely explained.
cards.gradeReason: Everyone said the same thing, same day, independently. Really. Powerful, but setup needed for full punch.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Chorus of branded animals singing one note simultaneously, conducting hand offscreen. Mood: Synchronized independence.

cards.power: Converts a claim into familiarity through repetition, and familiarity into assumed truth.
cards.lore: The claim does not become verified; it becomes recognizable — which produces a similar effect.
cards.gradeReason: Parrot finishes the sentence before it's said. Familiarity as truth. This one writes itself.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Parrot finishing dog's sentence while dog hasn't opened mouth yet. Mood: Mechanical pre-verification.

cards.power: Allows contradicting information to become inaccessible without active removal.
cards.lore: The prior account was not deleted; the new account was placed higher, in larger type, in more locations, for longer.
cards.gradeReason: Old article not gone — just page 47, smaller text. Inverse search. Cover quote lives here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Old headline buried under pile of newer larger headlines, still technically there. Mood: Displacement without deletion.

cards.power: Introduces change at a rate calibrated to fall below the threshold that reliably triggers active resistance.
cards.lore: Each step is unremarkable; the cumulative distance becomes significant only when measured from the original position.
cards.gradeReason: Boiling frog. Thermometer. Cumulative distance invisible from inside. Zero explanation needed. Classic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Frog in heating pot, thermometer nearing red, frog expression placid. Mood: Imperceptible cumulative change.

cards.power: Converts an exceptional condition into the standard through sustained duration and adaptation.
cards.lore: After sufficient time, the exceptional condition is no longer described as exceptional.
cards.gradeReason: Obelisk has been in living room long enough to be decor. Needs before/after beat to click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Animals living comfortably around glowing alien obelisk as if it is furniture. Mood: Adaptation as amnesia.

cards.power: Produces explanations that position the current state as the natural or inevitable outcome.
cards.lore: The trajectory is legible only toward the current position; alternative paths are no longer visible from here.
cards.gradeReason: All arrows point to where you are. Turtle drew the map after arriving. Lethal and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Turtle drawing map with all arrows converging on YOU ARE HERE star. Mood: Backwards inevitability.

cards.power: Converts sufficient duration into apparent permanence, and apparent permanence into natural fact.
cards.lore: Those who arrived after the shift describe the current state as normal. Those who arrived before it are fewer.
cards.gradeReason: Young squirrel thinks obelisk was always there. Older badger remembers. Generational — needs the contrast.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Young squirrel gesturing at glowing obelisk, confused older badger beside it. Mood: Generational normalization.

cards.power: Introduces a sudden cost increase that disrupts established behavior before alternatives can be organized.
cards.lore: The shock produces rapid adaptation; the adapted state accepts the new cost structure as the baseline.
cards.gradeReason: $10, $30, $50. Adapted. New baseline. Old price now the surprise. Market stall scene. Clean.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Animals at market, crossed-out price tags cascading upward, new prices baseline. Mood: Rapid adaptation to shock.

cards.power: Reduces — or appears to reduce — the supply of an essential good to redirect behavior at scale.
cards.lore: Scarcity may be real or managed; the behavioral response is structurally identical in either case.
cards.gradeReason: Real or managed — scramble identical. Shadow figure controlling grain pile. Immediate and visceral.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Shadowed figure controlling grain funnel above scrambling animals below. Mood: Managed or real, same result.

cards.power: Converts future income into present compliance through obligation structures accepted under prior conditions.
cards.lore: The harness is taken on voluntarily at a specific moment; the future it governs was not fully legible at that moment.
cards.gradeReason: Signed at one moment, governs the future. Future not legible then. Horse in fog. Needs breath.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Horse in debt-labeled harness pulling cart into foggy future, took it on willingly. Mood: Voluntary irreversible commitment.

cards.power: Reduces the real value of resources incrementally while the nominal value remains constant.
cards.lore: The number is the same. The quantity it purchases is smaller. The adjustment is continuous, distributed, and unremarkable.
cards.gradeReason: Same number, less stuff. Continuous, distributed, unremarkable. Squirrel counting — clever but subtle. Context helps.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Squirrel with same coin stack, last year nut pile vs. this year smaller one. Mood: Invisible incremental erosion.

cards.power: Makes the preferred option sufficiently easier than alternatives until alternatives become effectively unavailable over time.
cards.lore: The alternative remained technically accessible; the friction required to reach it accumulated into practical impossibility.
cards.gradeReason: Rainbow slide vs. impossible cliff. Both technically available. Hedgehog slides by default. Context helps.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Hedgehog on rainbow slide, cliff alternative labeled IMPOSSIBLE in background. Mood: Default ease concealing lock.

cards.power: Replaces human decision points with automated processes that cannot be questioned on the same terms as human decisions.
cards.lore: Responsibility for the outcome follows the system's design rather than the system's output.
cards.gradeReason: Processed. Beaver sits. Animals rage at glass. System doesn't care. Needs the indignation beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Beaver behind PROCESSED glass while animals protest, SYSTEM ERROR screen above. Mood: Bureaucratic untouchability.

cards.power: Produces consequential outcomes through processes whose criteria are inaccessible to those they affect.
cards.lore: The decision stands; the criteria are proprietary; an appeal is available at significant time and cost.
cards.gradeReason: Algorithm decided. Criteria proprietary. Appeal at significant cost. Dense but lands once named.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Animals reading output from glowing black box labeled PROPRIETARY ALGORITHM, key locked inside. Mood: Consequential opacity.

cards.power: Shapes available action through design until the design becomes the perceived space of possibility.
cards.lore: Users describe their choices as free; the choices listed were those that remained after the design was finalized.
cards.gradeReason: Grid shows choices. Everything outside grid invisible. Users call it freedom. Touchscreen cracked. Instant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Squirrel touching app grid, world outside icons invisible, ACCESS DENIED stamp. Mood: Designed perception as freedom.

cards.power: Attaches institutional credentialing to a position, elevating its authority above independent examination.
cards.lore: The seal confirms domain expertise; it also confirms institutional alignment with the body that issued it.
cards.gradeReason: Seal confirms expertise AND alignment simultaneously. Double function needs that second insight to click.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Owl at podium receiving gold seal that confirms both knowledge and institutional loyalty. Mood: Authority laundering.

cards.power: Circulates an aligned position through multiple institutional channels until simultaneous publication registers as independent consensus.
cards.lore: The positions arrived at similar conclusions within the same period; any coordination is not documented.
cards.gradeReason: Same conclusion, same window, independent. Coordination undocumented. Powerful when named, needs setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Identical reports fanning out from multiple institutional logos simultaneously. Mood: Synchronized undocumented consensus.

cards.power: Converts oversight institutions into endorsement institutions through sustained personnel and incentive alignment.
cards.lore: The regulator was designed to monitor the industry; over a sufficient period, the industry shaped the regulator.
cards.gradeReason: Fox approved the henhouse. Inspector hat unchanged, food chain rearranged. Recognizable, needs one beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Fox inspector in official hat approving collapsing henhouse with thumbs up. Mood: Captured oversight.

cards.power: Maintains the visible form of accountability while the functional capacity for it is structurally unavailable.
cards.lore: The committee convenes; the questions are asked; the record is complete; the practice continues.
cards.gradeReason: Committee met. Questions asked. Record complete. Raccoons escaped behind. Nothing changed. Instantly playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Suited animals asking earnest questions while raccoons escape with bags behind them. Mood: Theater of accountability.

cards.power: Redirects attention from a position's content to the credibility of its source.
cards.lore: The argument is not answered; the arguer's qualifications, history, or associations are examined instead.
cards.gradeReason: Don't answer the argument. Answer the arguer. UNQUALIFIED HACK neon sign. Zero setup required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Bird presenting blueprints, UNQUALIFIED HACK neon sign illuminating crowd behind. Mood: Redirection as dismissal.

cards.power: Removes the visible social infrastructure around a position until it appears to stand alone.
cards.lore: Others who hold the position become quiet; it appears fringe when it describes something widely experienced.
cards.gradeReason: Position removed from social proof looks fringe. Spotlight, one beaver. Needs the before/after to land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Single beaver under spotlight in empty arena, crowds visible but silent around edges. Mood: Structural isolation as fringe.

cards.power: Routes a position from high-distribution channels to low-visibility ones without formal suppression.
cards.lore: The position continues; it reaches a fraction of the prior audience; it no longer affects consensus-forming conversations.
cards.gradeReason: Still out there. Just not in the pipe. Crow at industrial valve. Sharp and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Crow routing content from wide industrial pipe to thin trickle output. Mood: Suppression without suppression.

cards.power: Converts the cost of contesting suppression into a structural disincentive for future challenges.
cards.lore: The case resolves; it requires years and resources beyond most challengers; the effect on future challenges is structural.
cards.gradeReason: Winning costs years and resources. Turtle carries precedent. Structure as deterrent — needs a breath.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Turtle carrying mountain of legal documents down endless institutional corridor. Mood: Cost as structural deterrent.

cards.power: Converts external behavioral requirements into internal monitoring, removing the need for visible enforcement.
cards.lore: The behavior is maintained without surveillance because the person no longer registers its absence.
cards.gradeReason: Dog has the rulebook. Warden's seat empty. You ARE the enforcement now. Chilling and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Dog reading rulebook alone in blank room, enforcement seat visibly vacant. Mood: Internalized surveillance.

cards.power: Binds behavioral compliance with self-concept until non-compliance requires personal revision.
cards.lore: The behavior is no longer performed for the institution; it is performed for who the participant understands themselves to be.
cards.gradeReason: Fox paints itself into team uniform at mirror. Compliance becomes identity. Non-compliance is self-betrayal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Fox painting team uniform over reflection in mirror, original coat disappearing. Mood: Identity as compliance.

cards.power: Converts a history of failed attempts to affect outcomes into a stable belief that outcomes cannot be affected.
cards.lore: The belief was rational given the prior evidence; it persists after the evidence changes.
cards.gradeReason: ACTIVE sign. Badger isn't pressing. Belief was rational once. It persists. Three-line lore. Knife.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Badger sitting beside ACTIVE lever, not pressing, history of failures in thought bubble. Mood: Rational belief, changed conditions.

cards.power: Produces consistent alignment without enforcement because the system's requirements have been adopted as personal values.
cards.lore: At this stage, no enforcement is required. The participants carry it for free.
cards.gradeReason: No enforcement required. System's requirements became your values. Everyone carries it for free. The endgame.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Vast hall of animals marching in perfect alignment, enforcement chairs all empty. Mood: Voluntary total compliance.

cards.power: Frames the identification of a recurring structure as evidence of interpretive error rather than pattern recognition.
cards.lore: Naming the structure is described as projection; the structure continues while the naming is contested.
cards.gradeReason: That's just projection. Tally marks multiply. Structure continues. Naming is the move. Sharp.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Fox pointing at tally marks, badger calling it projection, marks still multiplying. Mood: Naming contested while pattern runs.

cards.power: Maintains that repeated outcomes in the same direction are each individually and separately explicable.
cards.lore: Every instance has a different explanation; the explanation for the pattern is that there is no pattern.
cards.gradeReason: Each coincidence separately explicable. Explanation for pattern: no pattern. Owl with corkboard. Lethal.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Owl connecting red strings on corkboard, each node labeled with separate explanation. Mood: Systematic denial of pattern.

cards.power: Uses the genuine complexity of systems to make pattern description appear naïve or incomplete.
cards.lore: The system is genuinely complex; what it consistently produces is not.
cards.gradeReason: It IS complex. What it consistently produces is not. Beaver with equations, gold key inside. Perfect.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Beaver in hard hat pointing to key hidden inside wall of genuine equations. Mood: Complexity concealing consistent output.

cards.power: At sufficient scale of internalization, the pattern no longer needs to be performed — it becomes the ambient condition.
cards.lore: The move is complete when it stops being a move and becomes the environment.
cards.gradeReason: Pattern becomes the environment. FrizzleBob at desk, ACTIVE sign. That was always — sentence intentionally incomplete.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit at desk under ACTIVE sign, all previous deck cards wallpapering room. Mood: Recognition as the final move.

verdict: Fifty-six mechanisms, zero filler — The Move is the most technically precise deck in the corpus and it knows it. The cover tagline ('The pattern doesn't need you to believe in it. It needs you to not name it.') does more theory than most books. Named strength: The Acceptance Loop chapter (cards 49–52) is a masterclass — four cards that together describe the complete internalization sequence. Named weakness: The Tightening chapter rewards economically literate players; a facilitator beat helps land Debt Harness and Inflation Drift for general audiences. Table-ready: Y.
blurb: 56 mechanisms for how consent is manufactured, crises are managed, and compliance becomes voluntary. For anyone who wants to name what's actually happening — before it names them.

coverQA.coverVisual: 5 — FrizzleBob in trenchcoat spinning at notebook surrounded by alarm bells, pigeon bureaucrat stamping REJECTED/HUMBUG. Dense, energetic, perfectly on-brand.
coverQA.coverTitle: 5 — THE MOVE: A Field Guide to Managed Reactions. Field guide framing is both accessible and subversive. Best title in the corpus.
coverQA.coverVibeMatch: 5 — Alarms, documentation frenzy, bureaucratic pigeon, rabbit exposing patterns: matches every chapter of the deck exactly.
coverQA.coverOriginality: 4 — Familiar Kayfabizarro elements especially well-composed. The tagline is original and does standalone work.
coverQA.coverViral: 5 — Tagline will travel independently of the deck. Screenshot-able, quotable, argument-ending.
coverQA.coverNote: That pigeon stamping REJECTED while FrizzleBob documents the pattern is doing more political theory than most books. The tagline is the whole deck in one sentence and it will travel. Cover-to-content alignment: flawless.

notes: Chapter headers use decorative fonts (Bangers, Special Elite) — not present in card power/lore text. Marginal comments (BLÖDSINN!, KayfaBINGO!, What the FLUFF?!, KayfaBIZARRO!) baked into chapter pages as design elements, not card text. All card power/lore text in clean readable font — fontArtifactCount: 0. Existing grades retained — verified against PDF and confirmed accurate. The Move Itself (card 56) grade assigned G1: meta-card, player immediately knows what it is.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: THE MOVE – A Field Guide to Managed Reactions (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

The pattern only works while nobody says its name out loud. So let's say all fifty-six.

Here is the sequence, stripped of its costume. An alarm goes off and urgency walks in the door. The outrage gets pointed somewhere useful. A complexity shield goes up so no single person can ever be held to the floor. Oversight theater runs a matinee while the real decision was made before the doors opened. By the final beat nobody coerced you into anything. You comply on your own, you thank the room for the option, and you call it a choice. Fourteen sections, fourteen moments where the trick quietly changes hands, one repeatable machine that has been run on you more times than you have names for it.

The Move is a Social Story Wrestling deck pointed at the mechanism of control itself. You do not study the tactic from a safe distance. You pick up the card, perform the move out loud with a straight face, and the table rules whether anyone in the room would have caught it in the wild.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Move Core Deck: 56 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards across 14 sections, featuring The Voluntary Compliance, The Permanent Exception, and The Oversight Theater.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the Name-the-Pattern call that closes every round.
- The Control Map: every section sits on its own axis, from Urgency against Control to Anarchy-Lite against Void, so the full deck reads as a floor plan of how managed reality gets built.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this deck and you are not buying a static PDF. You are on the list. Every future section, capstone card, and topic-specific expansion in this cycle lands in your library as a free update.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because a pattern you can name is a pattern that loses its grip on you. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Run it. Name the thing the next time it walks past you in a headline. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and mapping the next sections.
Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"If you can name the pattern, you can see it again."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
